11.question: Aliza is 12 years older than Asad. When Asad was 6, Aliza was 3 times his age. How old will Aliza be when Asad is 14? (2)
11.facts: When Asad was 6, Aliza was 3 x 6 = 18, so the gap is 18 - 6 = 12 years, which never changes. When Asad is 14, Aliza is 14 + 12 = 26.

29.question: (Forces Academy Test 1 · Q29) What comes next: 62, 31, 34, 17, 20, ?
29.facts: The series alternates between halving and adding 3: 62/2 = 31, +3 = 34, /2 = 17, +3 = 20, so the next step is 20/2 = 10.
29.rel: Tip: when numbers rise and fall, check for two alternating operations.
